info.name: InvoiceIn — inbound e-invoice API
info.description:
Every e-invoice you receive, as one JSON.

POST an XRechnung, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, Peppol, FatturaPA or KSeF file — XML or hybrid PDF — and get canonical EN 16931 JSON, a validation report with plain-language fix hints, a readable PDF, and CSV or DATEV exports. One stateless endpoint per output, nothing stored.

**Try it now.** Every request below already carries a real XRechnung 3.0 invoice in its body, so Send works immediately: the demo quota is 20 invoices per IP per day and needs no key.

**With a key.** Set the collection variable `apiKey`; it is sent as `x-api-key`. A trial key is 100 invoices over 30 days — invoicein.peculiar.systems.

One invoice = one credit whatever outputs you ask for. A file carrying several invoices (a FatturaPA lot) costs one per invoice.

variable.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the keyless demo quota (20 invoices/IP/day).

query.description: Extras to add: validation, html, pdf, csv, datev (comma separated).
Language of the fix hints: en, de, pl, it, fr.

request.description:
POST any received e-invoice and get canonical EN 16931 JSON plus a validation report with plain-language fix hints.

The body below is a real XRechnung 3.0 (UBL) invoice, so you can press Send straight away — no key needed, 20 invoices per IP per day. Replace it with your own XRechnung, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, Peppol, FatturaPA or KSeF file; a hybrid PDF goes in the same way with Content-Type application/pdf.

Nothing is stored: the file is parsed in memory and discarded with the response.
